label: D2 rare a2->S1 after a rewarded trial, early in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 by a rare transition (97% of mass is in_state=S1 with in_action=a2). It almost always needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward=1 holds 100% of mass), and it fires only in the first ~50 trials of an episode (none after trial 60). In those early trials the policy is strongly a2-biased. All variables are observed at D2. Dev: P=0.60, R=0.85, F1=0.71, mass recall 0.96. False positives are mostly repeated rare S1 outcomes, where the unit stays silent on a second consecutive rare trial; requiring prev_common=1 raises precision only to 0.69 and costs recall. The small remaining mass (3%) is on a2->S2 common D2 steps with weak activations. Magnitude saturates (max is about 0.001 above threshold), so magnitude carries little information. It does not fire after a1 choices, on common transitions to S2 (beyond weak traces), or late in the episode.
